titolo: Alaska Is Hiding Something Most Americans Never Notice

scene.testo: Alaska is the westernmost and the easternmost state in America.
Its Aleutian Islands stretch across the 180th meridian.
So part of Alaska technically sits in the Eastern Hemisphere.
Here's how a state gets so strangely stretched out.
Alaska is more than twice the size of Texas.
It has over three million lakes scattered across the land.
Its coastline is longer than all other states combined.
Denali, its tallest peak, rises 20,310 feet above sea level.
But that's not the strangest part.
Juneau, the capital, cannot be reached by road.
You arrive by plane or by boat, nothing else.
Much of the state has no road connections at all.
In the Bering Strait, two tiny islands sit close together.
Little Diomede belongs to Alaska; Big Diomede belongs to Russia.
Only about two and a half miles separate them.
And the international date line runs between them.
Stay with me, because the next secret is even stranger.
